name: Lords Ishwar Hotels Limited
about: Lords Ishwar Hotels Limited engages in the hotel and restaurant business under the Revival Lords Inn name in India. It provides multi-cuisine restaurant, conference/banquets halls, and a health club. The company is also involved in the sale of wine and liquor. The company was formerly known as Ishwar Bhuvan Hotels Limited and changed its name to Lords Ishwar Hotels Limited in September 2010. Lords Ishwar Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Vadodara, India.
